editorial.blurb: A cozy neighborhood gem where wood-fired pizzas with perfect crusts and fresh ingredients arrive quickly, backed by attentive service that strikes just the right note.
editorial.insiderTip: Order on Saturday night for the full experience—your party will be seated promptly, and multiple pizzas arrive in quick succession, making it ideal for groups.
signatureDishes: White truffle oil portobello mushroom and artichoke pizza
